thought: The PostgreSQL executeQuery action requires the 'query' parameter to be set in params as a plain string. Currently, action_1 has empty params, causing the workflow execution failure. To fix this, I will implement action_1 to extract the SQL query string from input_data and set it as the 'query' parameter in params before running the action.
plan: Extract the query string from input_data inside action_1.
Set params['query'] to this extracted string as a plain string.
Set params['options'] to an empty dictionary as default.
Call the PostgreSQL executeQuery action with these params.
Test the action_1 to ensure it executes the query successfully.
